name: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 10
summary: Season 10 of The Crew Motorfest adds “The Motorfest Late Show” (a new playlist with monthly themes and 12 main events), new TrackForge Kit additions for Kaho’Olawe (“Street and Touge” plus Drift Trial/Drift Path with new drift kits and modules), and a new one-hour “Hawaii Grand Tour” time-attack. It also introduces new open-world stories starting August 5, beginning with Kai’s Garage and Project 356 (Porsche 356 reward), plus new radiant/elite bundles and upcoming collaborations.
